name: bondholder-rights-observatory
title: Bondholder Rights & Disclosure Observatory
description: Source-linked, instrument-level records of contractual protections and public disclosures for Indian listed non-convertible debentures. Every field is labelled `brdo:kind`: `identifier`: A key: an ISIN or the id of a record in this dataset.; `source_text`: Verbatim text from a source. Not covered by the dataset's licence, and cut to the source's quotation limit.; `read_from_source`: A fact the source states, transcribed or parsed by the project.; `annotation`: The project's classification or reading. Single-pass; not yet independently reviewed.; `derived`: Computed by code in this repository from other fields.; `provenance`: Where, when and how something was obtained, or the policy governing its use. `brdo:origin` says where a fact originates when that differs from the party that published it. Multi-valued cells are joined with `; `. The sample is selected on reported breaches and describes no market. Absence of a record is never evidence of compliance.

fields.name: published
fields.description: The date the publisher says the file was made public, for example on its listing page. Empty for most files: a server's Last-Modified header is never recorded here.

fields.name: published_basis
fields.description: Where the publication date was read.

fields.name: last_modified
fields.description: The server's Last-Modified header for the exact file held. It dates that version on the server, not its first publication; an earlier version may have been public sooner.

fields.name: available_not_before
fields.description: Lower bound on availability: the latest of the file's own date, its signature, its "as on" date and the dates of letters transcribed from it. The file cannot have been public earlier.

fields.name: available_from
fields.description: Estimated day this exact file became public: the later of the publisher's date and Last-Modified, never before `available_not_before`; failing both, the file's own date (a lower bound only); failing that, `available_observed`. Used by `brdo status --as-of` and `brdo show --as-of`.

fields.name: available_observed
fields.description: The day the project observed the file in public, which is when it retrieved it. The only availability date the record proves. Used by `--availability observed`.

fields.name: document
fields.description: Id of the cited file in `documents.csv`.

fields.name: page
fields.description: 1-based page of the file, not the printed page number, on which the item is printed.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: The passage, verbatim.

fields.name: relevance
fields.description: Why the project relies on it.

resources.name: instrument-status
resources.description: One row per ISIN and reporting period: what the reviewed record says about breaches, and on what basis. `no_report_found` is never evidence of compliance, and no status implies another.

fields.name: isin
fields.description: ISIN of the instrument, validated by its check digit.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: End of the reporting period.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status from a closed list; see docs/data-model.md.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: The rule that produced the status, including which kind of absence it is.

fields.name: documents
fields.description: Documents the status rests on.

resources.name: searches
resources.description: One row per documented attempt to find something, successful or not. A `not_found` means not found by the logged step on that date.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id of the search.

fields.name: performed_on
fields.description: When the search was made.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: ISIN, issuer id or source id the search was about.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: What was sought.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Web search, a source's listing page, or a direct address.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The query, for web searches. Results can differ when re-run.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Sites or pages searched.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: End of the reporting period sought, where one was.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: The project's classification of the result.

fields.name: documents
fields.description: Documents found and registered.

fields.name: urls_seen
fields.description: Candidates seen but not retrieved, such as manual-only sources.

fields.name: note
fields.description: The project's remark.

resources.name: discrepancies
resources.description: One row per disagreement or oddity in the public record, kept open until resolved. Nothing here is a finding about anyone's conduct.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id of the discrepancy.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What kind of disagreement it is.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: ISINs, issuer or source concerned.

fields.name: status
fields.description: `open` or `resolved`.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The project's neutral description.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: The anchors supporting the record, as `document#pPAGE`, separated by `; `. See `evidence.csv`.

fields.name: observed_at_urls
fields.description: Pages of sources whose terms forbid storing their content, such as depository databases, where the value was seen. The page's content is not stored and cannot be re-verified by machine.

fields.name: resolution
fields.description: How it was resolved, if it was.

resources.name: evidence
resources.description: One row per evidence anchor: a document, a page and the words relied on. `brdo verify` re-tests each against the hashed file.

fields.name: used_by
fields.description: Which record relies on the anchor.

fields.name: document
fields.description: Id of the cited file in `documents.csv`.

fields.name: page
fields.description: 1-based page of the file; empty when the anchor may be on any page.

fields.name: locator
fields.description: A human-readable position, where given.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: The words relied on, verbatim.

fields.name: read_from_rendering
fields.description: True when the words were read from the rendered page because the text layer may lack them. Such an anchor is machine-verified only if the words are found in the text layer anyway.

fields.name: ai_training_reserved
fields.description: True when the row derives from a source that publishes a reservation against AI training. Exclude such rows from any training or benchmark use.
